Subject: SOC2 packet + post-call recap / next steps

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet you on the demo earlier. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we’re aligned:

- What we covered: Redwood inference runtime, Dedicated/Private options, and how we handle customer data isolation.
- Security materials: I attached our SOC 2 Type II summary and evidence packet (Redwood_SOC2_packet_2026.pdf).
- Typical review flow: engineering/security review -> short security call if any questions -> legal/contracting.

Next steps:
1) I shared the SOC 2 packet with this email. Can you confirm if that’s the right doc bundle for your InfoSec review?
2) If helpful, we can set up a 30-min security deep-dive with our security lead next week.
3) Any date constraints on procurement or a target go-live? (helps prioritize dedicated capacity vs hosted).

I’ve cc’d Rishi to help coordinate timing from our side.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

We’re aiming to finish the first tranche of security reviews by the end of next week (3/12). I’ll follow up if InfoSec has any further questions.

Hi Sarah —

Just checking in to see whether InfoSec had any blockers after reviewing the SOC 2 packet. Quick notes that may help: 
- Retention: customers can configure retention windows for request/response logs. We also offer options for no-persist (ephemeral) modes for sensitive workloads; happy to have our security engineer share config examples.
- If it’s useful, here’s the shared folder with the packet + supplementary config snippets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-share

Would you be available for a 20–30 minute call with our security lead this week (Wed/Thu) to walk through the retention options? If the timeline has shifted on your side, can you let us know the new target so we can prioritize?

Thanks —
Marissa

(Attachment re-sent: Redwood_SOC2_packet_2026.pdf)

Following up — did InfoSec have any open questions after the packet? If the review is blocking procurement/timing, we should surface any blockers now so we can help. A few options from our side:

- Schedule a 30-min security deep-dive with our security lead (I can coordinate times).
